scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic algebra and a written analytic proof establish the parameter-uniform claim. Finite rational samples independently corroborate formulas but are not treated as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact statements concern a deterministic scalar quadratic with one-step stale accumulator in the denominator. They do not apply automatically to current-memory RMSProp or block-delayed private adaptive methods. Local orbital stability and repulsion only; no global basin claim or nonlinear classification at unit-circle crossing.
title: Sharp update-order instability of a one-step-lag RMSProp two-cycle
